newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks move into positive territory.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks move into positive territory.

text.p: The Dow industrials moved into positive territory Wednesday after easing at the opening on interest rate worries.
The Dow was up 4.42 points at 6966.45 and the Nasdaq composite was up 6.51 points to 1249.14.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was down 8/32 to yield 7.01, off morning lows, and the Standard & Poor's 500 index was up 1.80 points to 795.85.
The government today reported surprisingly strong Gross Domestic Product growth in the first quarter, and economists said the data could prompt the Fed to raise interest rates.
